wordProblems.q: 5 friends share the cost of a $30 game equally. How many dollars does each friend pay?
James watches a cartoon for 24 minutes and then plays outside for 27 minutes. How many minutes did James spend in all?
Ella needs 120 minutes to finish a puzzle. Ella has already worked for 21 minutes. How many more minutes does Ella need?
Ruby buys 4 packs with 8 stickers in each pack, then shares all the stickers equally with 3 friends, so 4 children share them. How many stickers does each child get?
A garden is 12 metres long and 4 metres wide. How many square metres is the garden?
Sophia earns $8 each week for 7 weeks. Sophia buys a ball for $49. How many dollars does Sophia have left?
Ava puts 36 marbles into bags of 9 marbles each. Ava finds 16 more marbles. How many marbles does Ava have in all?
Each bus holds 38 children. 3 buses are full, and 12 more children walk. How many children are going on the trip?
A recipe needs 5 eggs for one cake. A baker makes 3 cakes and uses 10 eggs for something else from the same box. How many eggs does the baker use in all?
Each pizza has 8 slices. There are 4 pizzas. The family eats 26 slices. How many slices are left?
Mason buys 5 books for $4 each and 2 pens for $3 each. How many dollars does Mason spend in all?
Lucas practises piano for 5 hours and then for 36 more minutes. How many minutes did Lucas practise in all?
A theatre has 6 rows with 9 seats in each row. 15 seats are taken. How many seats are empty?
A teacher has 6 packs with 8 crayons in each pack. She shares all the crayons equally among 3 tables. How many crayons does each table get?
Sophia gets $5 pocket money every day for 5 days. Sophia spends $14 on a toy. How many dollars does Sophia have left?
A cyclist rides 20 kilometres each day for 4 days. After 70 kilometres, how many kilometres are left to ride?
A garden is 7 metres long and 5 metres wide. How many metres of fence are needed to go all the way around it?
A shop buys toy cars for $6 each and sells them for $12 each. How many dollars of profit does the shop make on 8 toy cars?
Ethan plans to read 16 pages every day for 4 days. Ethan has already read 43 pages. How many pages are left to read?
There are 7 teams with 10 players in each team. How many players are there in all?
A rug is 9 metres long and 7 metres wide. How many square metres is the rug?
A table is 7 metres long and 6 metres wide. How many metres of ribbon are needed to go all the way around the table?
Emma buys 4 rulers for $12 each and 2 erasers for $8 each. Emma pays with $70. How many dollars of change does Emma get?
A runner runs 16 kilometres each day for 5 days. After running 56 kilometres, how many kilometres are left to run?
A child buys cups of lemonade for $3 each and sells them for $8 each. How much profit does the child make on 5 cups?
A baker makes 3 trays with 6 scones on each tray. She shares all the scones equally among 6 friends. How many scones does each friend get?
Jack practises violin for 1 hour and 35 minutes on Saturday and for 1 hour and 47 minutes on Sunday. How many minutes did Jack practise in all?
Sam earns $8 each week for 4 weeks and then spends $13 on a board game. How many dollars does Sam have left?
A classroom library has 5 shelves with 12 books on each shelf. The teacher lends 22 books to another class. How many books are left in the library?
Henry and 5 friends earn $78 washing cars together. They share the money equally. How many dollars does each child get?
